subject: acc-dy
title: ACC.DY.------INDIV.TD.
description: Chart on book p. 230 (T(IMP)M-28). ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the subject; INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), TRS (transition) and CULT-INFO-RT. From SPT-DY: BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: IST-F (isolated focus). From TRS: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From CULT-INFO-RT: DEF (definition, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of").
